PHYSICAL EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

3. Best practice when working on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   B. Practise Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

5. Best practice when working on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   B. Practise Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

7. Best practice when working on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   C. Practise Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.

8. Best practice when working on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   D. Damage equipment used for Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.

9. Best practice when working on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.

10. Best practice when working on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.

11. Best practice when working on Discus Throw: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Discus Throw.
   C. Practise Discus Throw with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Discus Throw.

12. Best practice when working on Shot put: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Shot put with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. In three clear sentences, explain Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
